title: Haye mazloom hasan
body:
haye mazloom hasan askari
mere imam hasan askari
<<DIVIDER>>
saamara mein phir chali karbobala ki jab hawa
jigar maula askari ka tukde tukde ho gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein binte nabi ka hogaya dil muztarib
haye maula askari ka dil bata tukdon mein jab
ye meri aulaad par zulm kaisa hai khuda
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ko aaya yaad phir beta hassan
zehr se chalni jigar tha khoon se tar tha kafan
jo mila kya hai yehi ajre risaalat ka sila
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein bhoole na maula askari karbal ke gham
jo huwe aale aba par shaam o kufa mein sitam
ya hussaina ya hussaina ki rahe de de sada
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
askari imam ke farzand e mehdi aayenge
har jagah farshe aza phir dekhna bich jayenge
khud bayan farmeinenge maula bayan e karbala
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
askari maula ka nauha ho likha aqil qabool
tujhpe raazi ho aneem hashr mein binte rasool
baargah e askari maula mein hai ye ilteja
saamara mein phir chali...
author: Saeed Aqil
